_doc: The three run modes of DESIGN section 5. runner/ffcore.py reads, for the selected FF_MODE: which stage kinds may run, which artifact classes may be taken from a saved copy under FF_DATA for each FF_USE_SAVED level, artifacts that must always be rebuilt in that mode, and train stages that are allowed in a mode that otherwise does not train. An artifact with no producing stage is always taken from FF_DATA (or blocked). A forced stage (FF_FORCE) always runs and ignores saved copies of its outputs.
always_saved_why: raw and collected data are the start of the chain (re-running 11_collect is optional and needs HuggingFace access: force it with FF_FORCE=<stage>); wiring datasets have no rebuild that would change a number; pretrained models are public files at pinned revisions. 'wiring' is a requirement-1 exception, not raw data: these frozen datasets are only checked by the verbatim code (presence / row counts); most have no producing stage (configs/data_map.json requirement1_gap, DESIGN G18)

train.title: (a) rebuild from the raw / collected data, except the frozen requirement-1 exceptions listed in requirement1_gaps
train.estimate: about 150-170 GPU-hours (T4) + about 10 CPU-hours, summed over the original runs; 4-6 days of wall time with several Kaggle accounts in parallel; one Kaggle session is at most 12 h (split with FF_ONLY)
train.expectation: recipe-level reproduction, not byte-identical (GPU training is not deterministic). NOT entirely from raw data: the requirement1_gaps artifacts (wiring datasets checked only for presence / row counts by the verbatim code, the frozen SAFE-04 tables, embedded data files) are taken frozen from FF_DATA because no stage of this repository rebuilds them (DESIGN G1, G18). Rows / LID lists should match exactly (ext-meta, lid_strict.json f4065711...), frozen features cos >= 0.999 against the saved copies, final per-file Spearman >= 0.99 against the submitted zip (proposed threshold, never measured). The retrained LoRA C1 is guarded by lineage (configs/variant_1354.json file_checks rule)
train.default_saved_note: datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-e2e-dev-p (frozen SAFE-04 tables), datasets/onnhqunhh/flag2027-rfs-lora-p (ORIGINAL LoRA C1) and the stored LID outputs (l42 / l150 / l152 / f41 / lid-strict-p) are used even in this mode (default_saved). Rebuild one with FF_FORCE=<producer> (safe04_lab, t163l_orig, ...). FF_USE_SAVED=none refuses the saved copies and then blocks consumers of force_only producers unless those are forced too
requirement1_gaps: datasets/ff-frozen/flag2027-e2e-dev-p (= frozen datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-e2e-dev-p, default_saved; safe04_lab can rebuild it with FF_FORCE=safe04_lab)
datasets/ff-frozen/flag2027-e2e-dev-wiring-p (dev-phase wiring members of the frozen SAFE-04 bundle; input of safe04_lab)
datasets/trngsnam/flag2027-feats-peface01-pe0-p (evidence only since 18/11: t183_p1 / t183_p2, whose arms request f_pel; dropped from t163p_c5rl, t213_p*, t216_p3, t163p_fvb, t189_b2 as never read)
datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-t3s01-tables-p (evidence only since 18/11: t184_report; t219_dumpv4 reads datasets/ff/flag2027-t3s01-trca-p made by t3s01_trca from ct02s-r2ca-tables-p)

11 data files embedded in stage code (configs/data_map.json class 'embedded'; 7 without producer: STACK-02/eligible.json, CLEANTUNE-01/ct_round2.json (hand-written configuration), VBSEL-01/vox2_sa_speakers.json, and the four frozen v9 / v11 / v12 fuser JSONs of e50cc, which feed only d['v9'] / d['v11'] / d['v12'])
train.requirement1_gaps_updated: 18/11/2026 (integration fixer r1, INTEGRATION_r1 B3 / M7 / M8)

full_rebuild_from_raw.command: FF_DATA=<data> FF_WORK=<work> FF_USE_SAVED=none FF_FORCE=raw_mavceleb,safe04_lab,f14_av,gather_g1 python runner/ffrun.py run --mode train --target final_verify   # one Kaggle / machine session per call: add --only <stage,...>
full_rebuild_from_raw.what_it_does: FF_USE_SAVED=none ignores default_saved (the stored LID outputs l42 / l150 / l152 / lid-strict and f41 are rebuilt) and every saved intermediate / checkpoint / run output; FF_FORCE adds the producers that the runner would otherwise never run: raw_mavceleb (MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 extracted from the two original zips instead of the extracted copy), safe04_lab (force_only: the SAFE-04 tables instead of the frozen copy), f14_av and gather_g1 (class wiring, always taken saved otherwise)

optional_force.why: re-collect VoxCeleb2 / VoxBlink from their public Hugging Face sources (needs HF_TOKEN with the ProgramComputer/voxceleb terms accepted); sampling depends on the network (failed tars), so the 13.54 rows come from the collected copies (DESIGN G9); with these stages the plan has 79 stages (~157 h by the original runs)

always_saved_by_design.datasets/onnhqunhh/flag2027-rfs-lora-p: the ORIGINAL LoRA C1 (lora_C1.pt b97372e3...) defines the 13.54 variant; every consumer has resolve: saved_only. t163l_orig (force_only) can retrain it as a check, but its GPU output has other bytes and is never mounted by the chain
always_saved_by_design.requirement1_gaps: the wiring datasets / frozen SAFE-04 members / embedded files listed above have no producing stage and stay frozen (class wiring / embedded)

full_rebuild_from_raw.plan_check: 18/11/2026, `ffrun.py plan --mode train --assume-saved` with this env: 71 stages, about 133 h by the original runs, no blocked input; with optional_force: 79 stages, about 157 h. Without FF_FORCE, FF_USE_SAVED=none blocks t155s_f12 (the frozen SAFE-04 tables have a force_only producer)

infer.title: (b) inference from the organisers' Evaluation media + released checkpoints
infer.never_saved_why: mode (b) starts from the organisers' evaluation_phase.zip: eval_set.zip is rebuilt by raw_evalphase (1 min CPU); run outputs of the Evaluation stages are recomputed (run_output is not in saved_classes)
infer.allow_train_why: dp_train (DP two towers, about 12 min CPU, deterministic on the team machine: S8 K6) runs when the saved towers (03_checkpoints/dp_towers) do not exist yet (DESIGN G5)
infer.required_why: the verbatim notebooks compute train-side constants inside the run (S5 gaps 5-8), so non-weight intermediate data are still needed (DESIGN 5.2)
infer.estimate: about 12 GPU-hours (16 + 21 + 240 + 221 + 31 + 162 + 34 min; the MAV part of e47rs, about 3.5 h, does not enter the zip) + about 1 CPU-hour
infer.expectation: Spearman >= 0.9999 per file against the submitted zip (the T2 test of release/flag2027_e2e reached >= 0.99999, max |diff| <= 0.06), not byte-identical
infer.expected_stages_note: DESIGN 5.2 list + raw_btc, the check of the organisers' v4 files that the runner schedules before the first stage reading them (stage.json outputs.verifies, request of WP-B); raw_mavceleb_check (WP-B, 18/11) is scheduled the same way: it verifies datasets/chnnhnnguyn/external-data-mavceleb before the first stage reading it
infer.required_intermediate_note: members-p, best-v7-p, cc5-oof-p, dsel02-oof-p, facelora03-tables-p and lab-avfull-p are requirement-1 exceptions (wiring, no producing stage); mode (b) on Kaggle: e50cc, e112f0sx, e112f1sx (literal /kaggle/input) each need their own session with exactly their inputs attached (runner/README.md)

assemble.title: (c) byte-exact assembly from the saved per-pair scores
assemble.never_saved_why: mode (c) recomputes the assembly from the per-pair scores: the saved posteval zips / sigma / final zip are the references, not inputs
assemble.soft_inputs_why: an input of an assembly stage whose producer cannot run in this mode (Evaluation / training runs) is mounted when a saved copy exists and otherwise skipped: the assembly stages find the flat score files in FF_DATA/05_scores themselves (stage.ipy of a_factor, a_fvbind, final_blend)

xjf_scores.npz.from: dp_train (English-only copy; the copy with Bangla 6a039faf... gives the same English z)

assemble.layout_note: the score files can be given flat (FF_DATA/05_scores/<file>, artifact scores/1354_inputs, as read by assembly/assemble_exact.py) or as per-run folders keeping the run-output relative paths (FF_DATA/05_scores/<run slug>/<run_output_path>, the alt_paths of the Evaluation run outputs in configs/data_map.json)
assemble.expectation: the four members of xjf_r10_trsig.zip byte-identical (configs/expected_sha256.json#xjf_r10_trsig); whole-zip SHA-256 only if the zip is written with the original member time (2026, 11, 16, 11, 8, 8) and DEFLATED

start_classes_why: the data the chain may start from (user requirement 1). Any other consumed artifact must have a producing stage; those that do not, or that the modes take frozen by default (class wiring, default_saved), are listed by `ffrun.py dag` / `plan` as REQUIREMENT-1 GAPS (configs/data_map.json requirement1_gap)
